title: outbox.provider.send@1 (decision kind, floor confirm, safety send): bound args
description: Send an Outbox draft on a channel a provider mod sends (inventory O6, Haystack P5): its manifest provides `outbox.channel:<name>`, and no first-party connector binds it. `provider` is REQUIRED and bound: the mod id whose `send` rpc sends it, so another provider of the same channel can't take the send. The bind is the draft as the Outbox shows it, `to`, `subject`, `body` by ref and `seen` (the Outbox's version of the draft), re-checked at claim; the executor hands exactly the bound {to, subject, body} to that provider's send. Preview rows: To, Channel, Provider, Subject, Body. Options: approve 'Send' (confirm), sendBack needsText (decide, verbFloors), decline 'Discard' (narrow).
